name: 78416 · Corp Christi, TX
findings: ZIP 78416 (Corp Christi) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78416 (Corp Christi) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78416 (Corp Christi) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 57% of the typical level).
